subject: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)

Team —

We’re aiming to send the updated AWS Marketplace listing package to Partnerships by Friday AM so they can start the partner portal submission workflow.

Can you please review:
1) Listing copy draft v3 (headline, long description, feature bullets, FAQs)
2) Asset checklist (screenshots + diagrams we need + owners)

Specific items I need eyes on:
- Copy: ensure Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private differentiation is crystal clear (and doesn’t over-claim on SLAs/security).
- Procurement path: confirm the “how it works” section aligns with the subscription → entitlement → Redwood org provisioning flow.
- Assets: confirm we have the minimum set for AWS review (console screenshots, onboarding flow diagram, security overview link).

Deadline: EOD Thu (Jan 15) for inline feedback; I’ll consolidate Friday 9am.

Attachments:
- Redwood_AWS_Marketplace_ListingCopy_Draft_v3.docx
- AWS_Marketplace_Asset_Checklist_v1.xlsx
- Console_Screenshot_Shotlist_v0.9.pdf

(Drive links if easier)
Copy doc: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QvAWSListingCopyDraftV3/view
Checklist: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QvAssetChecklistV1/view
Shotlist: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QvConsoleScreenshotShotlist/view

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference


From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)

Reviewed copy draft v3 — overall in good shape.

Edits / flags (high priority):
- Headline: recommend we avoid “lowest cost” language (AWS reviewers often push back). Suggest:
  Current: “High-performance LLM inference with lowest latency and cost”
  Proposed: “High-performance LLM inference optimized for latency, cost, and reliability”
- Dedicated section: keep “predictable throughput” but avoid hard numbers unless tied to contractual SLA (we can link to “Dedicated SLAs available” without quoting).
- Private section: tighten wording to “VPC and on-prem options” + “customer-managed networking and key management integrations” (don’t imply air-gapped is default).
- FAQ: add one question explicitly on “Can we pin model versions and rollout policies?” (this is a differentiator and keeps us away from competitive claims).

Edits (medium):
- In “How it works,” I tweaked step 2 to call out entitlement propagation delay can occur and we’ll show a retry path in Console.
- In “Security,” I replaced “SOC 2 certified” with “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA” (please keep consistent with Security packet wording).

I left comments in the doc, but summarizing here in case you’re moving content into the portal fields.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Marketing


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 12:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)

+1 on Soojin’s changes.

From Partnerships side (based on last cycle + what prospects ask for):
- Buyers want a very explicit support path in the listing. Can we add in FAQs:
  “How do I get support if I purchased via AWS Marketplace?”
  Include: support portal, expected response times by plan, and when to route to SE vs Support.
- Procurement note: include a sentence that private offers are available for committed spend / Dedicated capacity (without talking discount %).
- Terms: avoid language like “HIPAA-ready” in the public listing (we can say “designed to support regulated workloads; compliance documentation available”). We’ve had pushback from legal reviewers at accounts.

On assets: the checklist looks right. One more I’d like:
- A single slide-style diagram “Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private” (simple comparison table). This helps AEs a ton and also reads well in AWS listing images.

We’re using this listing for NorthPeak (HubSpot company id 12988401) — they keep asking “what exactly is Dedicated vs Private” and want it in writing.

Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales


From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 1:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)

A few exec-level guardrails before this goes into the AWS portal:

- No superlatives (“best,” “lowest,” “#1”). Keep performance claims framed as “optimized for” + point to benchmarks if we have them.
- Don’t mention specific competitors in the public copy.
- Security wording must match what Aisha/Olga are publishing for the marketplace security packet. If there’s any discrepancy, we’ll lose time in review.

Otherwise, direction is right.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
CRO, Redwood Inference


From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 3:09 PM PST
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)

Got it — we’ll remove/avoid all superlatives and keep claims tight.

Next steps I’m taking:
- Copy: incorporate Soojin’s headline + SOC2 phrasing update + add version pinning/rollouts FAQ.
- Support FAQ: I’ll add Stephanie’s question + route language through CS/Support owners for response-time accuracy (will keep generic where needed).
- Private offers: add a short FAQ line (“Private offers available for enterprise procurement and committed spend; contact Sales”).
- Assets: add requested comparison image (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). I’ll coordinate with Design once we confirm the exact rows/columns.

Ben — can you sanity check the “How it works” steps vs the latest onboarding funnel (esp entitlement delay + retry guidance) by tomorrow noon?

Camila


From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 4:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh — copy + asset checklist review (EOD Thu)

Yes — will review tomorrow AM.

Quick note now: in the “How it works” section, we should include a single sentence on what users see if entitlement isn’t available yet (e.g., “If AWS entitlement is still propagating, the Console will prompt you to retry and provides a status page link.”) That aligns with the UX changes Eng is implementing.

I’ll send a tightened step-by-step tomorrow with suggested wording.

Ben
Ben Carter
Growth / Onboarding Funnel
